text_block_list.text:
While walking through the school grounds, I found
Winning Ticket tilting her head and groaning.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmmm, hmmm...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Traiiineeeer!!
You're just in the nick of time~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When we were pacing each other during voluntary training earlier,
there was a moment where things felt kind of fuzzy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda like...
a tight squeeze, or a deep tug inside...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Did it get through to you!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right~~~~~?!
Urrrgh, what am I even supposed to say?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
Over there... is that...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooohh-heeeey!
Rice~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, did I scare you?
Sorry, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, more importantly!! You were doing
extra practice on the track just now too, right, Rice?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes...
That's true... but...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We crossed paths so I couldn't call out to you, but... you didn't happen to see me run, did you...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, yes... I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaay!!
Everything's gonna be fine now, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Rice is super observant, so she's
bound to figure out what feels off about my running!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Someone like Rice couldn't possibly say anything—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Plllleeeeeeeaaaaaseee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If thid keebd ub, I'll beee gloomyyy
foreeeveeerâ

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I can't even enjoy my food like this!!
Waaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, p-please don't cry...!
Um, um, ummm~...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... R-Right. I feel like...
my speed dropped a tiny bit near the end.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"When I was neck and neck with them... Ah, b-but
maybe Rice was just imagining things... though..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"What's this!?
Do you have any idea who it might be?"
choice_data_list: Let's train your explosive power more.
Maybe I was too focused on the opponent.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, explosive power, huh~~. That means being able to
accelerate at the final stretch... right?
choice_data_list: Let's check it at the next training session.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Rice is amazing, isn't she!
She really does observe things closely~."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, Rice was just...
saying it, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sooooo much!
You're amazing! A total genius~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Th-That's definitely not tr—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A genius Umamusume is hereeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyauuu, my voice is getting drowned out...

Leaving the apologetic Rice Shower aside,
Winning Ticket, whose gloom had cleared away,
was in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aah, come to think of it, towards the end,
it felt like we were all running together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that's whyyyy!!
I definitely felt like it was hard to runnn!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So from now on, I just have to make sure I don't freeze up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that clears up that lingering doubt!
Whew, what a relief!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...So amazing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What what what is it!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa... U-Um, I just think Ticket-san is amazing
for being able to bounce back so quickly...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Why? Rice can freshen up in no time too!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, then this time,
I'm tandem training with Riceーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyah... !?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together
and feel completely refreshed~~!!

Afterward, Winning Ticket forcefully... that is,
energetically secured a promise to train together
with Rice Shower, putting her in high spirits.
